Create the folders of a Where To Work project

Source: R/wtw.R
create_wtw_project_folder.Rd

Creates a Where To Work (WTW) project folder and the folders inside it, by default the layout wtw-data-prep2's step 01 creates (wtw_project_folders()). Use it to start a WTW project before writing its files with create_wtw_planning_units() and extract_wtw_natdata(), which also create the folders they write to. It creates folders only; create_dataprep_template() writes the dataprep/dataprep.csv template that step 01 also writes.

Usage

create_wtw_project_folder(project_dir, folders = wtw_project_folders())

Arguments

project_dir

The WTW project folder: a single folder path. It is created if missing, as are any missing folders above it. Where the project lives is each tool's own setting.

folders

The folders to create inside project_dir: a character vector of paths relative to it, with / or a backslash between folder names (a backslash is read as / on every system, so a list gives the same folders on Windows and Linux). The default, wtw_project_folders(), is the WTW project layout wtw-data-prep2 creates; wtw_project_folders(layers) takes the theme and weight folders from a NAT_DATA catalogue instead, and any other list gives another layout. The folders above each one are created too, so "tifs/themes/species" alone also creates tifs and tifs/themes. A folder named more than once is created once. NULL or an empty vector creates only project_dir.

Value

The paths of the folders in folders, invisibly: a character vector of file.path(project_dir, folders), with backslashes in folders turned into /, in the order of folders without repeats (character(0) when folders is empty). The folders exist on disk as a side effect.

Method

project_dir, then each folder of folders in order, is created with dir.create() (recursive = TRUE) unless it exists. Existing folders and the files in them are kept as they are, as wtw-data-prep2 does, so calling it on an existing project only adds the folders that are missing. Nothing is written or removed, and no file is created.

Arguments are checked before any folder is created: a folder path that is absolute, empty or NA, or that names an existing file, is an error. If a folder cannot be created (for example, without permission), the error names it, and the folders already created are kept.

With the defaults, the folders are those of wtw-data-prep2's step 01 (create_project_folder()): the same 32 folders inside project_dir. Decisions are recorded in ADR 0021.

See also

wtw_project_folders(), the default folder list.

Other wtw: create_dataprep_template(), create_wtw_planning_units(), dataprep_columns(), extract_wtw_natdata(), wtw_project_folders()

Examples

# Today's WTW project layout
project_dir <- file.path(tempdir(), "wtw_folders")
paths <- create_wtw_project_folder(project_dir)
list.dirs(project_dir, full.names = FALSE)
#>  [1] ""                                "aoi"                            
#>  [3] "dataprep"                        "dataprep/national"              
#>  [5] "dataprep/regional"               "dataprep/tmp"                   
#>  [7] "tifs"                            "tifs/excludes"                  
#>  [9] "tifs/includes"                   "tifs/themes"                    
#> [11] "tifs/themes/habitat"             "tifs/themes/species"            
#> [13] "tifs/themes/species/eccc_ch"     "tifs/themes/species/eccc_sar"   
#> [15] "tifs/themes/species/iucn_amph"   "tifs/themes/species/iucn_bird"  
#> [17] "tifs/themes/species/iucn_mamm"   "tifs/themes/species/iucn_rept"  
#> [19] "tifs/themes/species/ncc_sar_aoh" "tifs/themes/species/ncc_sdm"    
#> [21] "tifs/themes/species/nsc_end"     "tifs/themes/species/nsc_sar"    
#> [23] "tifs/themes/species/nsc_spp"     "tifs/weights"                   
#> [25] "tifs/weights/carbon"             "tifs/weights/climate"           
#> [27] "tifs/weights/connectivity"       "tifs/weights/eservices"         
#> [29] "tifs/weights/hotspots"           "tifs/weights/pressures"         
#> [31] "wtw"                             "wtw/metadata"                   
#> [33] "wtw/runs"                       

# The theme and weight folders of a NAT_DATA catalogue
natdata_dir <- system.file("extdata", "natdata", package = "constechr")
layers <- read_natdata_metadata(natdata_dir)
project_dir <- file.path(tempdir(), "wtw_folders_natdata")
paths <- create_wtw_project_folder(
  project_dir, wtw_project_folders(layers)
)
list.dirs(file.path(project_dir, "tifs"), full.names = FALSE)
#> [1] ""               "excludes"       "includes"       "themes"        
#> [5] "themes/habitat" "themes/species" "weights"       

# Another layout
paths <- create_wtw_project_folder(
  file.path(tempdir(), "other_layout"), c("aoi", "rasters/themes")
)
paths
#> [1] "/tmp/Rtmp4oO8r8/other_layout/aoi"           
#> [2] "/tmp/Rtmp4oO8r8/other_layout/rasters/themes"
